rundown: Wild beat Sharks 5-2 at SAP Center at San Jose in San Jose, CA in front of 15,710. Wild led 3-2 after two periods and never looked back. The 3rd period decided it: Wild won it 2-0.
7 goals in all. Wild's last: Joel Eriksson Ek Goal Wrist Shot, assists: Matt Boldy (18), Kirill Kaprizov (30), 3rd period 19:06.
Leading the way — Wild: Joel Eriksson Ek 2 goals; Kirill Kaprizov 3 ast, 4 pts. Sharks: Tyler Toffoli 1 goal; Macklin Celebrini 2 ast, 2 pts.
Where Wild won it: they outshot them 30-24 and out-hit them 28-15.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Wild closed as 1.5-goal favorites and covered by 1.5; the total closed at 6.5 and they combined for 7, over by 0.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 23, 9:57 PM ET. It had Wild 70% and Sharks 30%, projecting Wild 3.7 – Sharks 2.5 (6.2 total, Wild by 1.2).

Final: Wild 5 – Sharks 2. Right winner: it had Wild at 70%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Wild came in with a 4% above average attack and a 11% stingier than average defense (17-3-5, 3.6 scored and 2.2 allowed a game over 25 games), worth about 83 and 83 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.7, they scored 5 (+1.3 goals, 35% over); projected to allow 2.5, they allowed 2 (−0.5 goals, 19% under).

Sharks came in with a 5% below average attack and a 6% leakier than average defense (11-12-2, 2.8 scored and 3.6 allowed a game over 25 games), worth about 83 and 83 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.5, they scored 2 (−0.5 goals, 19% under); projected to allow 3.7, they allowed 5 (+1.3 goals, 35% over).

The bigger miss was Wild's scoring (+1.3 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 7 against 6.2 projected (+0.8), about the 63rd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.5).

Margin: Wild by 3 against Wild by 1.2 projected, about the 24th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.5).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.
